title: Rollback, backup/restore and release safety
problem: A release may be unrecoverable despite a nominal rollback command.
rationale: Before production; an irreversible migration needs a human decision, not a fictitious rollback command or an agent exception.
applicability: Registered production releases and applicable recovery/restore procedures.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: artifact-bound staged smoke, configured backup restore/recovery rehearsal and rollback/forward-fix runbook checks in disposable environments.
target_check.reviewer: reversibility, data retention and blast radius.

target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Before production; an irreversible migration needs a human decision, not a fictitious rollback command or an agent exception.

expected_evidence: **D:** artifact-bound staged smoke, configured backup restore/recovery rehearsal and rollback/forward-fix runbook checks in disposable environments. **R:** reversibility, data retention and blast radius.
